scripts.build: node node_modules/@opennextjs/cloudflare/dist/cli/index.js build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('.open-next/worker.js', '.open-next/assets/_worker.js'); ['server-functions', 'middleware', 'cloudflare', '.build', 'cache'].forEach(dir => { const src = '.open-next/' + dir; const dest = '.open-next/assets/' + dir; if (fs.existsSync(src) && !fs.existsSync(dest)) { fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true, dereference: false }); } });"
scripts.preview: node node_modules/@opennextjs/cloudflare/dist/cli/index.js build && npx wrangler pages dev .open-next/assets
scripts.deploy: node node_modules/@opennextjs/cloudflare/dist/cli/index.js build && npx wrangler pages deploy .open-next/assets
